text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the south side of Henley Crescent, between Kipling Avenue and Elmhurst Drive. In addition, parking be prohibited at all times on the north side of Henley Crescent, between Kipling Avenue and Watercliffe Road. The proposed changes will deter parking and reduce congestion in the area.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Henley Crescent, between Kipling Avenue and Elmhurst Drive (north intersection). 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Henley Crescent, between Kipling Avenue and Watercliffe Road.
